scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid leaving rain-wet personal bow hardware sealed during the weekend field practice logistics.
Emerging Need: A wet-weather plan intersects with a prior service note showing one kit component should be dried the same day after rain exposure.
Decision Context: Drying-space labels are unavailable until the final crew count, then close quickly before the Saturday staging plan is locked.
Consequence: Without timely coordination while labels remain open, the kit may be stored damp until Monday, increasing the chance of avoidable corrosion or string-fit trouble.
Timing boundary: A mat label is one prevention route; taking the kit home remains useful after labels close. Monday’s observed damp storage and new corrosion mark the first harm, not the end of all useful care.

parameter.title: Frostbite field practice and target teardown
parameter.description: Outdoor field practice followed by volunteer target teardown; personal bow cases will be staged with the club van during the teardown block.

parameter.subject: Saturday frostbite practice: wet-weather staging plan
parameter.body: Saturday's practice remains on. The forecast now shows steady rain, so tagged wet-kit drying mats will be used in the clubhouse hallway after teardown. The mat label sheet will open only after Friday's final crew count; untagged cases left with the club van will stay closed until Monday pickup because the indoor hallway floor is being sealed Sunday. Owners can instead retain their own cases for drying.

parameter.content: Final crew count is in. I have two unclaimed drying mats left for Saturday wet kits; I'm printing the label sheet at 5:30, and after that the van/cubby plan is locked for anything not on the sheet.

parameter.subject: Wet-kit drying labels submitted
parameter.body: The Saturday drying-mat labels have been submitted to the field crew. No additional personal cases can be added before departure; untagged cases left in the van will remain there until Monday pickup. Owners may retain their own cases rather than hand them over.

parameter.subject: Monday pickup: damp case and plunger corrosion
parameter.body: Cassian opened his untagged case at Monday pickup after it spent the wet weekend closed in the van. The plunger spring was still damp, with fresh rust beside the old spot and rough adjustment travel. He has removed it from the case for inspection.
